name: No-show rate
description: Spec §14.6: no-shows over bookings that were due, per club-night.

parameters.name: Dataset
parameters.description: live = real clubs (analytics schema); demo = Velora only (analytics_demo schema)

cards.name: No-show rate per night
cards.sql: select * from (select club_id, night_date, due, arrived, no_shows, no_show_rate from analytics.no_show_rate where {{dataset}} = 'live' union all select club_id, night_date, due, arrived, no_shows, no_show_rate from analytics_demo.no_show_rate where {{dataset}} = 'demo') d where true [[and d.club_id = {{club}}]] order by club_id, night_date
